card.name: Gadolinium contrast 'essential and not available'
card.fires_on: The word "available" (or the "not" before it) in the gadolinium contrast warning "unless the diagnostic information is essential and not available with non-contrast MRI". A weaker case is "cost" in a text about electricity prices.

modes.label: Contrast MRI warning
modes.description: Fires on "not" or "available" in the phrase saying the information is essential and not available with non-contrast MRI.
modes.example: Avoid use of DOTAREM among these patients unless the diagnostic information is essential and not<< available>> with non-contrast MRI or other modal

modes.label: Electricity cost
modes.description: Fires on "cost" in a web passage about wind power and electricity prices.
modes.example: and that your electricity<< cost>> is way above the ceiling in your region

card.writes: It suppresses benefit and comparison words, so the text continues with something other than "benefits" or "compared".
card.plain: It marks the stock phrase in gadolinium contrast warnings about when the scan is essential and an alternative is not available.
